hero.badge: The Modern CRM for Fast-Growing Teams
hero.desc: XOWIQ CRM is the all-in-one platform for startups and businesses to manage leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, and customer support — beautifully.

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything you need to grow
features.desc: A complete CRM toolkit built for modern sales teams. No bloat, just what matters.
features.smartDashboardDesc: Real-time analytics on revenue, leads, pipeline and activities. Everything you need at a glance.
features.leadManagementDesc: Capture, track and convert leads efficiently. Automatic transfer to contacts on conversion.
features.accountContactsDesc: Manage all your business relationships in one place with rich contact profiles and account hierarchies.
features.opportunityPipelineDesc: Visualize your entire sales pipeline with drag-and-drop stages and real-time deal tracking.
features.ticketSupportDesc: Handle customer queries efficiently with priority-based ticket management and status tracking.
features.reportsInsightsDesc: Generate comprehensive reports and download them as PDFs. Stay informed about your CRM performance.

howItWorks.label: How it Works
howItWorks.title: Simple. Powerful. Fast.
howItWorks.desc: Get started in minutes and see results immediately.
howItWorks.step01Desc: Create your account in seconds. No credit card required.
howItWorks.step02Desc: Bring in your existing contacts and leads effortlessly.
howItWorks.step03Desc: Manage your pipeline and convert leads into revenue.

videoDemo.title: XOWIQ CRM — See how it works
videoDemo.subtitle: Confidence, speed, and no fluff. A complete tour of the XOWIQ ecosystem.
